title: How One Hard Thing Before 8 AM Trains a Godly Man to Say No
caption:
A godly man tells his body no before 8 AM. Not to earn anything from God. Because a man who can say no at 7 can say no at 11 PM.

Pick one small hard thing. Do it before you feel like it. Thank God when it's done.

What's yours going to be tomorrow?

#faith #discipline #godlymen #christianman #selfcontrol #mornings
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
